pages.text: Ore Cluster can be found in the world and need $(l:ore_drills/ore_drills)Ore Drills$(/l) to harvest resources. There are different ore cluster types and each holds different resources. Ore clusters are unbreakable and endless amount of ore can be harvested from them.

There are different cluster types and the output might vary depending on installed mods. For output details refer to JEI. Each type has a different mininglevel. Higher mininglevel need bigger drills or better drill item materials.
pages.title: Cluster Types

pages.text: Calculating the required power per tick and amount of output is quite complicated. The following numbers are involved: $(li)$(l)Clustersize$(): amount of connected cluster blocks $(li)$(l)Cluster Mining Level$(): can be seen on the block tooltip $(li)$(l)Drill Radius$(): value from 0 to 4. 0 is a drill consisting of only $(l:ore_drills/ore_drills#tinydrill)controller & rod$(/l), for others it is radius including middle block.
pages.title: Formulas

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Drill Rod Size$(): amount of rod blocks in the drill$(li)$(l)Engine Size$(): the height of the engine block, which is the number of engine blocks between rod and controller.$(li)$(l)Drill Item Mining level$(): can be seen in the tooltip of the drill item. $(li)$(l)Global Ore Multiplier$(): read from config file$(li)$(l)Global Power Multiplier$(): read from config file
pages.title: Formulas

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Cluster Ore Multiplier$(): Cluster type individual multiplier, displayed in the block tooltip$(li)$(l)Cluster Power Multiplier$(): Cluster type individual multiplier to power, displayed in the block tooltip
pages.title: Formulas

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Effective Mininglevel$() = $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas2)Drill Item Mining Level$(/l) + $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas)Drill Radius$(/l) - $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas)Cluster Mining Level$(/l). The $(thing)Effective Mining Level$() must be >= 0, otherwise the drill will only output cobblestone$(br2)$(li)$(l)Effective Cluster Size$() = Minimum ( $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas)Clustersize$(/l), ( $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas2)Drill Rod Size$(/l) + $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas2)Engine Size$(/l) ))
pages.title: Derived Variables

pages.text: $(thing)Ores per Hour$() determines the ore output per time and is calculated the following way: ( ($(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas4)Effective Cluster Size$(/l) * 3 ) + ($(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas4)Effective Cluster Size$(/l) * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas4)Effective Mining Level$(/l) * 0.5 ) ) * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas3)Cluster Ore Multiplier$(/l) * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas2)Global Ore Multiplier$(/l)$(br2)
pages.title: Ores Per Hour

pages.text: The required power per tick is calculated the following: 8 * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#ores_per_hour)Ores Per Hour$(/l) * ( 1 + Maximum ( $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas)Drill Radius$(/l) - 1, 0 ) * 0.2 ) * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas3)Cluster Power Multiplier$(/l) * $(l:ore_drills/ore_clusters#formulas2)Global Power Multiplier$(/l)$(br2)The Power per Tick directly determines the RF requirement. Consuming Liquid or Solid Fuel has an own multiplier for fuel to RF.
pages.title: Power Consumption
